Tools / 02

Create variations from one color code

Choose a base color and step. The tool mixes sRGB channels with black or white; these are candidates to test, not automatic recommendations.

Result

Codes and results are processed in your browser; values are not sent to a Vijeron server.

Formula and limits

Each variation channel = round((1 − p) × base channel + p × white or black channel). Five positions: dark two steps, dark one, base, light one, light two.

This sRGB channel arithmetic is neither physical paint mixing nor perceptual interpolation. Test each real text/background pair in context.

Build palettes by role, not swatch count ↗

A solid-pair checker and mathematical color variants, not a whole-page accessibility audit or aesthetic guarantee.
